docs.summary: Attribute applied to methods to register them as menu items. Supports validation methods, priority ordering, icons, and separators.
The menu path for this item, e.g. "GameObject/Create Empty".
When true, the attributed method is a validation function that returns whether the menu item should be enabled.
Sort order for this menu item. Lower values appear first. Default is 1000.
Optional icon name to display alongside the menu item.
When true, inserts a separator before this menu item.
When true, the item acts on the whole selection itself instead of being run once per multi-selected target.
